role: Structure block probe: over a raw region generates every mineshaft start wholly inside it chunk by chunk (cx-major) with the population Random seeded as ChunkProviderGenerate.populate seeds it, recording per step every block write, the tile entity delta, constructed entities and the 3x3 hash: the reference for structure_blocks.c and mineshaft_blocks.c.
used_by: make -C oracle run CLASS=StructureBlocksProbe (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"StructureBlocksProbe"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
notes: Temporarily flips WorldConf.minecarts on for its own run so chest minecarts appear, then off again (moves no recorded value). Output manifest.json, steps.bin, writes.bin, tileentities.bin, entities.bin, final.bin.gz. No oracle/src hook.
